Londin. edit. insignitor auctam Annokationibus Honrici Stephani Locupletatus</TITLE>. Nova cura retensuit digessit &c. <AUTHOR>Ant. Birrius</AUTHOR>. <FORMAT>fol.</FORMAT></BIBL> Ingleichen geben sie auch den <BIBL><TITLE>T. Lieium e. Integr. Sigonii & Gronovior Norit</TITLE> in <VOLUME>3. Voll.</VOLUME> auf schön Schreib-Median- Pappier in <FORMAT>8.</FORMAT></BIBL> à <PRIZE>fl. 6.</PRIZE> künfftige Wochen an die Herren Liebhaber aus, dieser Preiß aber währet nur biß Ende Januarii <YEAR>1740</YEAR>. nach welcher Zeit kein Eremplar unter <PRIZE>7fl. 30. xr.</PRIZE> verkaufft werden solle.</ITEM>",
  "number_of_fixes": 4,
  "explanation": "1) Escaped the bare ampersand in the abbreviation '&c.' (et cetera) as '&c.' – a raw '&' is illegal in XML text content. 2) Escaped the bare ampersand in 'Sigonii & Gronovior' as '&' for the same reason. 3) The second <BIBL> element was never closed, so the document was not well-formed; added </BIBL> after the <FORMAT>8.</FORMAT> element, which ends the bibliographic description of the Livy edition (author/title, volume count, format), keeping the prices, delivery notice and year – which belong to the advertisement text rather than to the bibliographic record, consistent with the first <BIBL> – outside it. 4) Repaired the mojibake produced by a Mac-Roman/UTF-8 double-encoding (√§→ä, √º→ü, √∂→ö, √†→à, √ü→ß) so that the 18th-century German text (Buchläden, ausgelüffert, schön, à, künfftige, Preiß, währet, biß) is legible again. The OCR spelling errors in the original print (e.g. 'Subseribenten', 'Annokationibus', 'Honrici', 'Eremplar') were deliberately left untouched as they are part of the transcribed source, not XML faults."
